title: New social classes: the middle class and the workers
goal: Say who the new middle class and the workers were and what they asked for, reporting what historians and workers said.
grammar: reporting with según and decir que (recap)

items: Say who belonged to the new middle class.
Say who the workers were and what they asked for.
Name the 1884 and 1912 laws in Argentina.
Use *según* and *decir que* to report what others say.
